Update.DescriptionOfChange: Updated Xpaths for elements in Forms B122A-1, B122A-2 in the Individual Bankruptcy Petition Business Rules Matrix. Updated error messages for Forms B101, B106I, B106I-Supp, B106J, B106J-Supp, B106J-2, B106J-2Supp in the Business Rules Matrix. Updated Bankruptcy schema for Creditor Matrix definition.
Update.Author: The Administrative Office of the US Courts

Update.DescriptionOfChange: Removed Owner attribute and created separate definitions for Debtor1 and Debtor2 in Forms B101, 106I, B122A-1, B122B, B122C-1. Please check for Employment and Income details changes. Created Debtor1ExemptProperty and Debtor2ExemptProperty definitions replacing 106CDebtorSection in Form B106C. Included NeworUpdated Indicator in Form 106H definition. Updated definitions for Income and Prior Address in Form B107. Renamed definitions for StatementSecuredClaims and StatementLeaseEntity in Form B108. Replaced AccountType with FinancialAssetType in Form B106AB. AddressRecipientName is not used in Creditor Matrix definition.
Update.Author: The Administrative Office of the US Courts

Update.DescriptionOfChange: Added Subchapter element to the B101 schema to implement the Small Business Reorganization Act, effective 02/2020. It is applicable to both NextGen CM/ECF BK 1.3.3 and 1.5.1 versions. The XML sample file with the the Subchapter element, called NG1.3.3_CH11_Individual_Bankruptcy_Petition.xml, can be used for both NextGen versions.
Update.Author: Karen Daly (The Administrative Office of the US Courts)
